keyLimits.en: Centralized contractor management, payments in 120+ currencies, automated invoicing, tax-form guidance, worker classification compliance.
Adds compliant misclassification protection on top of contractor management.
Co-employment across all 50 US states, managed payroll/tax filings, benefits (healthcare, dental, vision, 401(k)).
Full legal employment in 130+ countries via Employer of Record, automated onboarding, on-demand HR/legal/tax support.

addOns.en: Find Talent (recruiting): $14 per worker/month for job posting, AI-powered screening and interview scheduling.

cautions.en: Pricing is per worker/employee, not a flat account fee, and varies widely by hiring type: $49/contractor/month for management vs $599/employee/month for global EOR.
No long-term contract required (month-to-month available), but total cost scales directly with headcount across each hiring category used.

capabilities.en: Global payroll, contracts and Employer-of-Record services covering 150+ countries.
Contractor payment automation with invoicing and tax-form (e.g. W-9/W-8) guidance in 120+ currencies.
US PEO co-employment offering managed benefits and payroll tax filings across all 50 states.

limitations.en: No free tier; every hiring type (contractor, PEO, EOR) is billed per person per month starting at $49.
EOR pricing at $599/employee/month is materially higher than direct local payroll for companies already established in a country.

reason.en: HR/IT/payroll platform covering overlapping global workforce management needs.
HR platform sometimes compared for core HRIS features, though narrower on global EOR.
